# dsh-skill-gate
English | 中文
## Summary
`dsh-skill-gate` adds **per-session skill visibility control** to DeepSeek Harness. A compact contro
l in the composer tool row — right next to the permission control — opens a checklist of every skill
the current session's composition can see. Uncheck a skill and it leaves the session completely: it
disappears from the model's `<available_skills>` catalog, the `skill` tool refuses to load it, and
`/name` gestures stop injecting it.
This is the visual, reversible equivalent of a CLI's `--skill x,y,z` flag. It exists for one job: wh
en many skills live in a shared directory such as `~/.agents/skills/` and several of them conflict a
cross business contexts, you decide — explicitly, per session — which ones the model may use, so the
model cannot hallucinate its way into the wrong playbook.
The default stays exactly DSH's native behavior: **every skill enabled, no restriction**, until you
exactly DSH's native behavior: **every skill enabled, no restriction**, until you uncheck something.
| Piece | Role |
| `index.js` (Host) | Wraps the `skills` service's `list`/`snapshot`/`get` with per-session filterin
g; persists gate state to `~/.dsh/skill-gate/state.json`; serves two authenticated `/api` routes on

the connection's shared channel |
| `client.js` (Browser) | The `conversation.input.left` slot contr

ol: a borderless tool-row pill plus a grouped, searchable checklist popover |

One loader row; the browser half is discovered through the package's `dsh.client` declaration |
## Features
- **Native look and feel.** The control adopts the composer bar's borderless tool-row design (chevro
n, hover wash, 13px medium label) and opens a menu-surface popover that flips upward when the viewpo

rt is short.
- **Grouped, searchable checklist.** Skills are grouped by source root — project `.dsh/
skills`, project `.agents/skills`, custom directories, user `.dsh/skills`, user `.agents/skills`, bu
ndled, and runtime — so business skills stand apart from built-ins. Search filters across name, desc

ription, and path.
- **One mental model: checked = visible.** The stored state is an allowlist of ex
actly what the model sees. Checking everything collapses back to the unrestricted default (`null`),

so "back to normal" is always one click ("Enable all") and never drifts.
- **Enforced at the registr
y boundary.** Filtering wraps the live `skills` registry, so the durable catalog published at every
agent step, the `skill` tool's lookup, the `/name` gesture injection, and the UI's session skill lis

t all agree — no partial views, no stale entries.
- **Instant, durable, hot-reloadable.** Changes ap
ply on the model's next step (DSH republishes the catalog automatically) and persist per session id.
The state file is written atomically and watched, so hand edits and external tooling stay in sync.
A *default* scope covers sessions that have no selection yet (including new sessions before the firs

t message).
- **Zero dependencies.** The bundle imports nothing from `@deepseek-ai/*`; every capabil
ity is reached through injected Cordis services, following the same `connection.fetch` channel patte
rn as `dsh-context`.
## Requirements

- Node >= 22.19.0
- A DSH runtime that satisfies `engines.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.3`), with the skills capa
bility mounted (any profile built on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`)
## Install
From a clone of this repository, install the bundle into a profile with the Plugin Manager (`install
_bundle`, target = the absolute package directory) or the `dsh` CLI. Then refresh the Web UI — the b
rowser half is fetched at page load.

The profile links the checkout, so editing `client.js` takes effect after a page refresh, and editin

## Usage
1. Look at the composer tool row: the control reads `技能 · 全部` (everything enabled). When a session h

as an active restriction it reads `技能 N/M` with the glyph and count tinted blue.
2. Click it. Unchec

k skills that do not belong to this session's business context. Each toggle persists immediately.
3.
The next model step carries the reduced `<available_skills>` catalog; disabled skills are un-loadab

le by the model and by `/name`.
4. Click **Enable all** (or re-check everything) to return to the un
restricted default. In a session-less composer the control edits the *default* scope inherited by ne
default. In a session-less composer the control edits the *default* scope inherited by new sessions.
Newly installed skills are detected dynamically through the filesystem provider's watchers and appea
r in the picker on the next open; while a restriction is active they start unchecked, keeping the al
on the next open; while a restriction is active they start unchecked, keeping the allowlist honest.
## State
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`default: null` means "no restriction". A per-session entry overrides the default; `null` inside `se
ssions` is normalized away. The file is the source of truth — edits are picked up live via an fs wat
ch — and writes are atomic (temp file + rename). Entries are pruned past 500 sessions.
## Limitations
- **Subagents do not inherit the gate.** Forked/spawned children run under their own session ids and
fall back to the default scope. This is deliberate: delegated tasks are usually orthogonal, but per

-child gating can be added if a use case demands it.
- **Host code updates need an application resta
rt.** A linked install serves `index.js` from the checkout; the running host caches the module per p

rocess.
- The Host half wraps the `skills` service's public `list`/`snapshot`/`get` contract (the sa
me methods DSH's own `tool-skill` calls). If a future DSH version renames them, the plugin logs a wa
rning and degrades to "no restriction" rather than breaking sessions.
